key_insight: Random splits reward recipe memorisation, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals which models generalise to unseen perovskite solar-cell data.
engineering_relevance: More rigorous evaluation can help engineers select models for genuinely new device recipes, fabrication settings, and research environments.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Apply progressively stricter splits isolating duplicate devices, publications, and institutions.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another; tree ensembles lead on random splits, but composition-aware neural models excel on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Reliable grouped evaluation depends on accurate recipe matching and publication and institutional provenance metadata.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
